newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine says Canadian arrest of diplomat illegal.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine says Canadian arrest of diplomat illegal.

text.p: Ukraine accused Canada on Thursday of illegally arresting a Ukrainian diplomat who was expelled this week after being charged with drunk driving, bribing a police officer and possession of stolen property.
"The arrest was illegal," Foreign Ministry spokesman Yuri Serheyev told a news conference held after vice-consul Olexander Yushko, 32, returned to Ukraine.
Serheyev said Canadian police violated the Vienna Convention, which grants foreign service personnel diplomatic immunity.

Ukrainian authorities said Yushko had a blood alcohol level three times the legal driving limit when he was arrested at the end of October, but that police misinterpreted his attempts to pay a fine on the spot as an offer of a bribe.

They also said a police search of Yushko's car, which yielded a pair of stolen license plates, was illegal under the Vienna convention. They said the diplomat's driver had found the plates and meant to return them the day after the arrest.
Yushko was declared persona non grata last Monday and given two days to leave Canada.
"The police did not behave in a civilised way," Serheyev said. "They treated him like he was a criminal."
Foreign Ministry officials said the incident would not affect Canadian-Ukrainian relations.
